title: Video by metromedia.house
description:
Everyone knows the PayPal Mafia.

but look at what came after it.

Peter Thiel went on to build Palantir. Palmer Luckey went into defense. Alex Karp turned Palantir into a force in intelligence and military tech.

the weird part is how much of Silicon Valley’s defense world traces back to that same network.

and Palantir sits right in the middle of it.

#palantir #founder
